title: Food and Beverage Minimum Assessment, Resort Club Memberships
content:
In the months of the level's food and beverage minimum season, when the food and beverage a Resort Club Memberships member charged in the month is below the level's monthly food and beverage minimum, the difference is invoiced after the month ends, once per month.

## The quantities

- **Food and beverage charged in the month** — the total of the amounts of the membership's member charges in the food and beverage category whose date of sale falls in that calendar month. The amount of each charge is the member price signed to the club account.
- **Shortfall** — the level's monthly food and beverage minimum less the food and beverage charged in the month, where that is above zero; where the member charged the minimum or more, the shortfall is nil and nothing is invoiced.
- **Timing** — the shortfall is invoiced after the month ends, as one food and beverage minimum charge for that month; a month is assessed once.

## Assessment table (hypothetical figures)

At a level whose monthly minimum is 75.00 in a minimum-season month:

| Food and beverage charged in the month | Shortfall invoiced after the month ends |
|---|---|
| 0.00 | 75.00 |
| 52.40 | 75.00 less 52.40, that is 22.60 |
| 75.00 | Nil — nothing invoiced |
| 80.00 | Nil — nothing invoiced |

## Points of judgement

- **A month outside the minimum season:** the minimum applies only in the months of the level's minimum season, so no shortfall is assessed for other months.
- **A level with no minimum:** where the level's monthly minimum is 0.00 and no season months are listed, no shortfall arises.
- **Two charges for one month:** a month's shortfall is invoiced once.
